text.body:
<śavdārthaciṃtāmaṇi>
oṃśrīmahāgaṇapatayenamaḥ oṃyadīyāṃghridvaṃdvāṃbujamajatato vījavidhikādapi śrīmataḥsyurhya(jha)ṭitigatabhāgyāpijanāḥ amuṃmāhiṣmatyāḥpatimaminamatyādijananaṃsadāvaṃdevaṃde kamapikṛtavīryyātmajatanuṃ <1> natātparyyajñohaṃgiriśavaca sāṃnāpicadṛśoḥsapāṃthāsaṃdehaṃgamayatisuiraṃhya(jha)ṭitiyaḥ tathāpyetattaṃtrāṃbunidhitaraṇemecapalatāṃkṛpābhiḥ śrībha rtturnahisadupahāsāyabhavatu <2> śavdārthaciṃtāmaṇiredhvanā matograṃthobhavatpremanidherdvijāddhiyat natatravitraṃkṛtavī ryyanaṃdanaprasādalabhyaṃkimihāstinepsitaṃ <3> śāradātila kasaṃjñanivaṃdheṭippaṇānivahuśaḥpravaraṃti tāvatāpicapa riśramametaṃsārthakīkurutasāravidojñāḥ <4> athasaṃsārāpā rākūpāranimagnānsādhujanānuddharttuṃguṇavattattamūrttisamupā sanāprakāraṃbhagavatāśivenopadiṣṭamapinigūḍhatātparyya katayāvagaṃtuṃ sutarāṃpunaranuṣṭhātumaśakyamavakalayya<0> tamevārthaṃnānātaṃtraikavākyatayaikarūpatayāniścityasukha vodhāyasugamaśavdairnivaṃdhaṃnavamāvikīrṣurlakṣyaṇāvāryyo nivaṃdhaparisamāptivighaṭakavighnavyūhavidhvaṃsanāyamaṃgala manuṣṭāyaśiṣyaśikṣāyainivadhnāti nityetyādi aniśami tidvitīyārthābhivyāpteraniṣṭābhāvānukūlavyāpārarūpāva nenvayaḥ astivanityasyāpyabhāvasyasatvātsatvapratītiprayo jakatayātaddhārakaṃvyāpāreprayojakatvaṃsarvajanasiddhaṃ aniṣṭa nivṛttistunatadekadeśaḥ dhvaṃsarūpāyāstasyāḥpratiyogisā pekṣatayāyatrapratiyogīsvakāraṇābhāvādevāniṣpannastatrā prasiddheḥ prāgabhāvarūpastadanutpādopinatadekadeśaḥ prati
yogyanutpattisthaletatprāgabhāvepramāṇābhāvāt viti svīya vākyajanyavodhāśrayatayoddeśyatvarūpaṃsaṃvodhyatvenākrāṃtaśiṣyā rthakayuṣmatpadottaradvitīyārthavṛttitvasyāvanaikadeśāniṣṭā bhāvenvayaḥ aniṣṭānvayenuyādṛśavyakteraniṣṭamaprasiddhaṃtatrā nvayānupapattiḥ syādatobhāvetikvavidaniṣṭavatipratiyogī prasiddheva nanugraṃthāraṃbhekosyamahasaḥprasaṃgoyenaprastuta graṃthavighnanāśakasyagaṇapatervācāmadhiṣṭhātṛdevātāyāḥ sarasvatyāvāsmaraṇamapahāyāmuṣyānusaṃdhānamityatrāha vā cāmityādi tatkiṃsarasvatyākhyaṃmahaḥsāṃprataṃsmṛtiviṣayī bhūtaṃnetyāha nityānaṃdetyādi nityoyānaṃdaḥsevavapuḥsva rūpaṃyasyetimahasoviśeṣaṇaṃ nityaṃvijñānamānandaṃvrahmeti śruteḥ ānaṃdaṃānaṃdavat arśādyav tenanapuṃsakatvamupa pannaṃ ānaṃdavatvaṃtādātmyasaṃvaṃdhenanātobhedāpattiḥ yadvāni tyoduḥkhāsaṃbhinnānaṃdoyobhyevaṃbhūtānivapūṃṣiyeṣāmevaṃ bhūtairniraṃtaraṃsaṃsārasyānāditvenāparichedyatvenavapratikṣaṇaṃ galadbhirabhivyaktaiḥ kṣakārasyakrādivatsaṃyuktākṣyaratayāpārtha kyenāgaṇanātpaṃcāśan saṃkhyairarṇairvarṇaiyenamahasāidaṃjagadvyā ptaṃtadityarthaḥ kāvyādibhyohiśravaṇasamanaṃtaramevaniratiśa yānaṃdaḥ sāmājikānāṃjāyate vedāṃtādivākyaśravaṇāccapa raṃparayāmokṣarūpāṃnaṃdātiśayobhavatikeṣāṃcidinitatprayo jakatvaṃvarṇānāṃ sarveṣvapighaṭapaṭādiśavdeṣutādṛśārtheṣuca tattadvyaktisaṃketitapadapratipādyatayāsarvanāmapadapratipā dyatayāvakathaṃcicchavdārthavyāptirvarṇānāṃ nanuśavdabrahmaivavyā pakaṃitikaścidāvaṣṭe aparastujīvātmanāmaṃtargataṃcaitanya
mevajagadvyāpakamitivrūte itaraścaṃdraśekharevavyāpakiti vadeti tadetanmattatrayaṃtvanmataviruddhaṃsyādityatrāha śadde tyādi tathāvapadamātrasyabhedonanāminorthasyetimattatrayā viruddhamevāsmanmatamityabhiprāyaḥ yattuaḥkeśavastena vasaṃkarṣaṇastanmūrtibhedatvāt tenacaukāraḥ keśavādinyā seṣusaṃkarṣaṇamūrtteścaturdaśasvareṇasahanyāsapratipādanā tniśāhakāraḥ akāreṇasahitāniśāyasminnitima hoviśeṣaṇaṃ śaśāṃkasyārddhavaṃi(caṃdra)viṃdvoḥsadanamitihauṃiti prāsādavījamanenoddha(ddhṛ)taṃ evamanyānyapivījānigraṃthārtha itipadārthādarśakṛtoktaṃ tannayuktaṃ kliṣṭavyākhyāpatteḥ na hikliṣṭepyarthegraṃthakarttuḥstātparyyaṃyenatadanupapattyāṃtatoni ṣiddhalakṣaṇayāsasorthāvaśyakaḥsyāt nanuprācīdigva danoyaditrisaṃdhyāsupaṭhedetaṣṇaṇmā(?)saṃvijiteṃdriyityādeḥ saptaviṃśatidinaparyaṃtamekaviṃśatisaṃkhyayākavacapāṭha paratvamupagacchata stavakathaṃparakīyaklaṣṭavyākhyānadūṣaṇe pravittiriticet bhrāṃtosi nahivayaṃsvapāṃḍityaparivodhanā yatathāvyākhyāmatusarāmaḥ kiṃtukavacoktāṣvaprayogāyetva yoktāḥkāmadhenavaḥkathaṃtedevakarttavyāvidhinākenasiddhi dāityādipraśravākyādyanurodhāt anyathākavacavacanāpra tipādyasyāpiprayogasyasaṃhitāyāṃpratipādanenākāṃkṣitā bhidhānāpatteritisaṃkṣepaḥ vācāmadhīśatvaṃcedatrayīmayatvā devaṃbhūtaṃśāśāṃkasadanaṃviṃduśiraskaṃvāgbhavavījaṃgraṃthāraṃbhe vaśyaṃsmaraṇīyaṃ avyādityarthaṃkecidāhuḥnāyamarthaḥkliṣṭo pi <1> nanulokasiddhakāraṇatākairevakulālādibhiḥghaṭādi
kāryyasiddhyākiṃmahasotiriktasvīkāreṇa athakṣityādi karttṛtvennatatsiddhiritivenna tasyanirguṇatvābhyupagamena karttṛtvāsaṃbhavāt athakiṃcicchaktisaṃbaṃdhātkartṛtvopavāra mātraṃ tatrakarttrītutacchaktirevetivrūṣe tarhitvadīyagraṃthani rmitipratibhādānavighnanivāraṇādikartryapisaivabhaviṣyatī titatsmaraṇamatyāvaśyakamityabhipretyāha aṃtaḥsminetyā di hāsyepīdamevakāraṇaṃyatkāraṇatvābhāvepyasyaparavra hmaṇaḥkāraṇatvamāvakṣatesaṃsāriṇiti <2> nanumahasaḥpa ravrahmaṇaḥsaśaktikasyāstunāmasmaraṇayogyatvaṃ paraṃnutatsma raṇamakārevāsulabhaḥ athakasyacidgurorupadeśavākyaista tsaulabhyamitivrūṣenarhiparamopakārakatvāttadīyamevasma raṇamāvaśyakamityabhipretyāha saṃsāretyādi <3> iṣṭasādha natājñānasyapravṛttisāmānyelaukikapravṛttisāmānyevā hetutayāvināsvīyeṣṭasādhanatāgrahamannagraṃthepaṭhanādaupra vṛttiḥśiṣyāṇāṃnopapadyatityataḥsvīyagraṃthārthajñānaphala mādarśayati sāramisādinā naṃtrāṇāṃsarveṣāṃnatuyatkiṃci dekataṃtrasya taṃtrāṇāṃnānābhūtānāmadarśanehikvacideka taṃtrasyatātparyyārthaṭhakvacitpadārthaḥkvacidākāṃkṣitabhāgā rthaścanirṇetumaśakyaḥ sāraṃsatisaṃbhavesarvataṃtrāṇāmeka vākyatayāpratipāditamarthaviśeṣaṃ natunānāvākyārthabhū tānivaikalpitayānuṣṭeyāni vāsarāṇi etenanehekataṃ tropāttopyaparataṃtraviruddhorthonavāsvakapolakalpitorthaḥ pratipādyityuktaṃ yannunityānaṃdetyādinaivaślokenasvagraṃthapra yojanaṃ darśitamitigūḍhārthadīpikākāreṇoktaṃ tannayuktaṃ
tataḥspaṣṭaṃtādṛśārthānadhigamāt sāraṃvakṣmāmītyādervairasyāpa tteśca <4> nanukiṃtatsāraṃyadatragraṃthepratipādyanityākāṃkṣāyāṃ saṃkṣepeṇasarvamapisvagraṃthābhidheyamāha śavdārthetyādi yattuvi ṣayaprayojanasaṃvaṃdhādhikāriṇaḥśrotṛpravṛttinimitta bhūtā ndarśayati sāramityādiślokadvayenetyuktaṃpadārthādarśakṛtā tattusāramityādyekaikaślokenaivasarvoktārthapratipādanepita syaivapunarvivaraṇarūpatayādvitīyaślokasyāpekṣaṇenayathā kathaṃcitsaṃgamanīyaṃ ślokadvayasyaikavākyatātunavakṣyāmī tyādikriyāpadadvayavairasyāt lokadvayasyaikavākyatātuna vakṣyātyādikriyāparadvayāvairasyāt yasmindharmādīnāṃkā raṇaṃtattadupāsanāprakārobhidhīyate tādṛśaṃśāradātila kagraṃthaṃvakṣyāmītivaiyyadhikaraṇyenānvayaprasaṃgaśca mamatve vaṃpratimāti śiṣyāṇāṃviṣayāṃtaramanoviccherāyapravarttaka jñānasaṃpattayecasāramityādigraṃthasyaivaviśeṣaṇaṃ nanugraṃtha syaivadharmmārthādikaṃpratikāraṇatvaṃvyavasthāpitaṃ tatkiṃstotrā divatpāṭhamātrāt kiṃvātadarthajñānāt āhosvittatpratipādyā rthānuṣṭhānādityatrāha śavdetyādi tathācamaṃtrāṇāṃvidhiprati pādanenatajlānaṃtataścānuṣṭānaṃ tataḥsamīhitasiddhiritirī tyāgraṃthasyāsyajñānamiṣṭasādhanamitisarvathāetadadhyayanā dauyatinavyamitibhāvaḥ maṃtraprāptividherapimaṃtravidhitāvi vakṣitā tenapratijñāślokākroḍīkṛtasyadīkṣāvidheratrapra tipādanepinakṣatiḥ śaraḥsvataṃtraṃ tasyabhāvaḥśāraṃsvātaṃtryaṃta ddadātītiśāradā tasyāstilakobhūṣaṇaṃ etenānvarthanāmata yāsarvāpekṣayāyamevagraṃthupādeyityuktaṃ sarasvatyāstilaka
syasarvagraṃthamapekṣyotkarṣāditidhyeyaṃ <5> athodeśakramaprā ptāṃśisṛṣṭimabhidhātumupakramate nirguṇityādinā āva śyakaṃvedaṃsṛṣṭinirūpaṇaṃ anyathāvakṣyamāṇabhūtaśuddhyādau svasvakāraṇeṣukṣayasyatattatkāraṇāttattadutpatteścadurkṣeyatvā yatteḥ sanātanityanenasarjakānavasthāparihṛtā anyaḥa saṃgṛhītaprakṛtikaḥ guṇāḥsatvarajastamāṃsi tadūparigraha parigrahābhyāṃnirguṇatvasaguṇatvoktiḥparavrahmaṇaḥ sāmyā vasthāviśeṣāpannāuktaguṇā evaprakṛtiravidyākalāvā bhidhīyaṃte <6> tadevaṃrītyādvividhaparabrahmamadhyedvitīyācha ktirjātā śaktirapiguṇavaiṣamyeṇasthūlāvasthāprakṛtipa nnāprakṛtireva tadevaṃsāmyenasūkṣmāvasthāpannāyeguṇāḥpra kṛtyavidyākalāparaparyāyāstadviśiṣṭāvrahmaṇaḥsakāśā tsthūlāvasthāviśeṣāpannaguṇāparaparyāyāśaktirajāyate tinirgalitārthaḥ āsīdityasyāvirbhūtetyarthaḥ yaduktaṃvā yavīyahyahitāyāṃśivechayāparāśaktiḥśivatatvaikatāṃga tā tataḥparisphuratyādausargetailaṃtilādiceti etenaśa ktisahitādevavrahmaṇaḥsakāśāchaktirutpannetikathaṃni rvaheditipratyuktaṃ śaśibhedasyopapāditatvāt sakalatve pivrahmaṇaḥsṛṣṭisāmarthyādikaṃnapracyutaṃbhavatītisūvapi tuṃ savvidityādi avidyākavalitatvenapareṣāmevaiśvaryya vyutirnāmuṣyetibhāvaḥ tataḥśakte sakāśāt nādoviṃduścā vasthāviśeṣāveva yathāhikapālikākapālaghaṭakharpyarā disaṃjñāmṛdaḥ <7> paraśaktimayaḥ śivaśaktimayaḥ asausāklā dvrahmatvenanirdiṣṭoviṃdurevapunaḥ pūrvoktaviṃdunādābhyāṃkāra
ṇabhūtābhyāmaparānevaviṃdvādīnsvabhedanayābhajamānastraivi dhyayupadadhāti tatrasūkṣmasthūlābhyāmavasthābhyāṃbhinnāva sthāparāvasthātāmāpannoviṃduḥatevaśivatvenāsauka thyate sūkṣmāvasthāmāpannonādaḥatevāśakyoccāraḥsthū lāvasthāmāpannaḥkāraṇabhūtoviṃdurevapūrvoktovījapadenā bhidhīyate astuvāparaśaktimayityapyavasthāsūcakameva śaktipadaṃsthūlāvasthāparaṃ sthūlāvasthāpannāyāevapūrvaṃśa ktitvenapratipādanāt tataḥparābhinnāvasthāparāvasthāsū kṣmāvasthācetiitthamevasārthakyamapyetadviśeṣasya <8> teṣāṃ bhedānāṃsvarūpamāha viṃdurityādinā vījasyadharmitayāpūrva mutpannādapinādātmakasaṃvaṃdhātpūrvamuktinaṃvairasyāya sama vāyaḥkṣobhyakṣobhakabhāvalakṣaṇaḥsaṃvaṃdhaḥ svakapolakalita tvabhramanirāsāya sarvetyādi <9> raudrītyādi śavdasṛṣṇaṃtarga tāetenirodhikārddheṃduviṃdurūpāḥkrameṇarudrādināmatāmā sādayaṃti tevacajñānaśaktīcchāśaktikriyāśaktipadenāpya bhidhīyaṃte sadāśivādbhavedīśastatorudrasamudbhavityādikaṃ tvarthasṛṣṭyabhiprāyeṇavakṣyati nātaḥpūrvāparagraṃthavirodhaḥ <10> bhidyamānāttrividhatvenabheditāt parātdvitīyāt yadvāyasya trayobhedāuktāstasmānṛmūlabhūtāt parārdvidoḥprathamamupā ttānnatūttarataḥ avyaktovarṇatvādiviśeṣadharmmairavibhāvya ātmāsvarūpaṃyasya <11> taṃravamevasarvāgamavirśaradāḥśaṃkarā vāryyaprabhṛtayaḥśavdavrahmapadenavyavaharaṃti kecittu āṃtaraspho ṭevaśavdārtharūpaḥśavdabrahmapadenavyavahāryyaḥ isāhuḥ pare tupūrvapūrvavarṇasaṃskārarahitavaramavarṇagrahaṇodvuddhapadaspho
ṭādikamevaśavdavrahmetyāvakṣate <12> tadetanmatadvayaṃdūṣayati nahīti tayoḥśavdārthaśavdayoḥ siddhiḥśavdavrahmapadavācyatāsiddhiḥ yataḥsaccidānaṃdarūpovrahmaśavdārthastaucajaḍauitibhāvaḥ caita nyamiti pūrvapūrvavarṇasaṃskāraviśiṣṭaścaramavarṇevasarva bhūtacaitanyopaditaḥsarveṣāṃvākyārthābhivyaṃjakaḥśavdavrahmapa dārthatāmāsādayatītigraṃthakārasyābhipretaṃ atevasphoṭo pyanyāyyakalpanitimaṃtavyaṃ <13> tatśavdavrahmaprāṇināṃma nuṣyamukhyāṇāṃdehamadhyāṃtargatakuṃḍalīṃprāpyāsādyatadanaṃta raṃkaṃṭhatālvādyabhidyātadvārākakhagādivarṇānāvirbhāvayat gadyapadyādibhedatonānāprakāratāmādhatteitiprakṛtagraṃthani rūpaṇīyamaṃtrasṛṣṭiḥpratipāditā <14> athamaṃtrārthataddevatā sṛṣṭimabhidhātumarthasṛṣṭiṃvaktumupakramate athetyādinā yattumūlabhūtāttatovyaktādityāditevārthasṛṣṭerupakramaḥ idaṃtupūrvoktaśavdasṛṣṭikramasyaparyyavasitasyahya(jha)ṭitivo dhārthaṃpunarupādānamitiharṣadīpikākṛtoktaṃtannamuktaṃsa dāśivāderapyarthatayātatsṛṣṭerarthasṛṣṭitvasyavārayitumaśa kyatvāt anyathāgrerudrasyagaṇanādarthatvamevatasyanaprāpye ta evaṃkramasyapūrvamanuktatvenatadanuvādatvāsaṃbhavāca śaṃ bhoḥparavrahmaṇaḥsakāśāt pūrvaniruktārthakalāpadārthā tmakāt kalāmevāśrityakāryyakāritvaṃnasvātaṃtryeṇetie kakāryyakāritayātadātmakatvopacāraḥ kālasyāpijagajja nanesahāyabhūtatayātadātmakatvoktiḥ śaṃbhornirguṇavrahmarū pasyakathaṃkarttṛtvaṃkathaṃvānayadākadācidyasyakasyacidutpa ttirbhavatītiśaṃkādvayamanenaviśeṣaṇadvayenaparihṛtaṃ
viṃdvātmakaṃtvavasthāviśeṣarūpaviṃduprayojakṛtayākāryyekā raṇopacārāt etadupādānaprayojanaṃtuviṃdudvārakamevasa dāśivaprayojakatvaṃśaṃbhoritisūcitameva jagatsākṣī ja gatsṛṣṭisthitidhvaṃsanigrahānugrahātmakakāryyapaṃcakakarttā kecittu pūrvaṃśavdasṛṣṭeruktatayāmāyāvījasyāpyutpattiruktai va tataścasadāśivotpattimāha athetyādinā śaṃbhorhakārā t kālogniḥrakāritiyāvat pralayesarvanāśakatvasyāgreḥ satvātkālatvoktiḥ savaṃdhurivayasyekavījaghaṭakatayāta tsaṃpādakatvāt etāvatāhakāramāvirbhāvyakāmakalāpadā rthabhūtalaturthasvaraparatvenakalāpadaṃnirvarṇyaḥ sātmani yasyetiśaṃbhorviśeṣaṇaṃkṛtvāsaṃpūrṇamāyāvījoddhāraḥkṛtaḥ yattukālārddheṃduḥātmācaturthasvaritipadārthādarśakṛto ktaṃ tannayuktaṃ tathāsatiśaṃbhoritipaṃcamyaṃtasyasāmānādhi karaṇyānāpattermūlasvārasyabhaṃgāpatteḥ athahakārāt rakā rāt arddheṃdutaścacaturthasvarāccasadāśivojātityarthaḥ mā yāvījaprāptistuparasparamilitāditipūraṇādinābhavatu māvetivrūṣetarhiviṃdvātmanityādivaiyadhikaraṇyakṛtaṃgraṃ thāsaurasyamaparihāryyamevetivruvate <15> teṣāṃśavdapṛṣṭaunā masādṛśyamātreṇapratipādanabhramaviṣayāṇāṃrudraprabhṛtī nāṃevaṃpūrvoktaślokārthakrameṇa śavdasṛṣṭautvanyathākrama uktonārthaparobhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ <16> idānīmarthaviśeṣa bhūtasṛṣṭiṃvaktumupakramate mūletyādi mūlabhūtātsarvasṛ ṣṭimūlabhūtāt paravastunaḥ paraṃvrahmapadavācyān avyaktā n varṇatvādibhirviśeṣadhammeramabhivyaktāt ebhirviśeṣa

riṃśadvyaṃgulādhikaṣoḍaśāṃgulaparimitenaguṇitaṃbhūmyarddhamā naṃdvādaśarūpaṃṣaṭtriṃśadvyaṃgulapramāṇaṃ <20136> saṃpadyaṃteevaṃdvi tīyatryasrasyalaṃvamānenadvādaśāṃgularūpeṇabhūmyarddhamānasya dvādaśāṃgularūpasyaguṇanevedavedadharaṇīpramitaṃkṣetraphalaṃbha vati ekaikavṛttārddhasyahyekonatriṃśadvyaṃgulādhikāṃṣṭāṃgula pramāṇovyāsitivṛttārddhadvayasyamilitvāṣṭa <58> śaravyaṃgulā dhikaṣoḍaśāṃgulānivyāsapramāṇaṃsiddhyati vyāsebhanaṃdāgni <392> bhirguṇiteṣaṭcatvāriṃśadvyaṃgulādhikanaṃdavāhurasaṣaṭ <66626> pramitāṃkoniṣpannaḥatrakhavāṇasūryye <1250> bhāṃgehate jātātriparidhipramāṇaṃtripaṃcā <5> idaṃgulāniaṣṭādaśa <18> vyaṃgulānicaturdaśa <14> prativyaṃgulāni etenaparidhimānena pūrvoktavyāsapādasyacaturthāṃśasyakramācaturdaśatriṃśatpramā ṇakāṃgulavyaṃgulaprativyaṃgularūpasyaguṇanejātāni <26> ṣa ṭtriṃśatyadhikadviśatīgulāni <5> paṃcavyaṃgulānipaṃcāśa <50> dvyaṃgulānikṣetraphalaṃ eteṣāṃtrayāṇāṃkṣetraphalānāṃyogenajā taṃsaṃpūpūrṇayonikuṃḍakṣetraphalamekasaptatyutarapaṃcaśatāṃ gulāni <501> ekacatvāriṃśadvyaṃgulāni <41> paṃcāśatprati vyaṃgulāni <50> bhavati atrapaṃcāṃgulānivaṃdrāvdhivyaṃgulapaṃ cāśataprativyaṃgulābhyāṃnyūnānihastamātracatusrakṣetraphalānnyū nānibhavaṃti arddhacaṃdrevyāsoṣṭastriṃśadaṃgulāni <38> vyaṃgulāni caturviṃśati <24> tatraparidhipramāṇaṃviṃśatyutaraśatamaṃgulā ni <220> aṣṭatriṃśadvyaṃgulāni <38> paṃcadaśaprativyaṃgulānitena vyāsacaturthāṃśenavāṃgulaṣaṭtriṃśadvyaṃgularūpeguṇitesatini ṣpannāṃkogajavāṇarudrāṃgulapramāṇakaḥsaptavyaṃgulakodvādaśapra tivyaṃgulakaśca ||
<1158>|<7>|<12> idaṃsaṃpūrṇavṛttakṣetratadarddhaṃmekonāśītyadhikapaṃ caśatāṃgulāni <50> trīṇi dravyaṃgulāniṣaṭtriṃśat <36> prati vyaṃgulāniprakṛtavṛttārddhakuṃḍakṣetraphalaṃbhavatītikiṃcidadhi kaṃtryaṃgulaiḥprakṛtibhūtacaturasrakṣetraphalādadhikamatrakṣetra| phalamāpatatīti kecinmanoktetrikoṇelaṃvamānepaṃcada| śaprativyaṃguladrapramāṇavyaṃgulādhikaikatriṃśatpramāṇāṃgu larūpeṇabhūmyarddhamānasyāṣṭādaśāṃgularūpasyaguṇanejātaṃtriṃ śatprativyaṃguladvāviṃśativyaṃgulādhikacaṃdratuvāṇāṃgula pramāṇaṃkṣetraphalaṃbhavati vṛttakudrevyāsa<0> ṣaṭviṃśatyaṃgulā nicatvāriṃśadvīgulāni <26401> paridhipramāṇaṃṣaḍaśītyaṃgu lāniṣaṭcatvāriṃśadvyaṃgulānitrayastriṃśatprativyaṃgulāni <06>|<46>|<33>| nyāsacaturthāṃśasyaparidhināguṇitatvelavdhāṃka saṃkhyāgajavāṇaśarāṃgulā|<558> nitriṃśadvyaṃgulāniviṃśatpra tivyaṃgulāni <20> kṣetraphalaṃbhavati| ṣaḍasrekuṃḍeṣaṭtryasrāṇi samāni tatrāpilaṃvaguṇaṃbhūmyarddhamitirītyāekatryasrasyakṣe traphalaṃsaptanavatipaṃcaviṃśatiḥsaptatriṃśaccāṃgulavyaṃgulapra tivyaṃgulānibhavati laṃvamānaṃsarveṣāṃpratyekaṃdvādaśāṃgulā ni ekonaṣaṣṭivyaṃgulāni paṃcaviṃśatiprativyaṃgulānibhū mimānaṃpaṃcadaśāṃgulāni tadarddhaṃsārddhasaptāṃgulāni idaṃṣaṭgu ṇitaṃdvyavdhiprativyaṃgulayuktavahnivahnyunmitavyaṃgulataḥsame taiḥvedāṣṭapaṃcāṃ <584> gulakairniruktaṃmanīṣibhiḥkṣetraphalapra māṇamiti pūrvoktacaramamatepadmakṣetrasyavyāsapramāṇaṃ eko natriṃśadaṃgulānidvipaṃcāśadvyaṃgulāni aṣṭacatvāriṃśatpra| tivyaṃgulāni tasyavargāṃkapramāṇaṃdvinavatyuttarāṣṭaśataṃaṣṭaca
tvāriṃśadvipaṃcāśaccāṃgulādirūpaṃnasminbhanavāgninā <3627> nāguṇitemaṃpatrāṃkaḥdvyaṣṭaśūnyarasaśūnyavāṇatripramāṇāṃgu lāni <3506012> ekonaviṃśati <19> vyaṃgulānicaturviṃśatipra tivyaṃgulāni <24> tatrapaṃcasahasrāṃ <5000> kenabhāgehṛtebhūvyoma lailāṃgulāni <24> dvādaśa <12> vyaṃgulāniekonaṣaṣṭi <59> prati prativyaṃgulānītipadmakṣetrasīmāvṛttekṣetraphalamupadarśitaṃ i damevacapatrāgravṛttapadenāpyabhidhīyate yatramadhyavṛttasyakṣe traphalaṃyathā tadvṛttasyavyāsaścaturviṃśatyaṃgulāni <24> tasyava rgāṃkaḥṣaṭsaptatyuttarapaṃcaśatarūpaḥdhanadhāgninātasyaguṇane bhujaśaranavacaṃdrartudvivāhu <2291952> pramāṇoṃkaḥtasyapaṃcasa hasrāṃkenabhāgaharaṇedvipaṃcāśaduttaracatuḥśatāṃgulāni trayo viṃśativyaṃgulānipaṃcaviṃśatiprativyaṃgulānicaphalamāyā taṃ <452>|<23>|<25> uktakṣetraphalenasahāsyakṣetraphalasyayogerāma vāṇavidhubhūmitāṃgulaṃ <153> ṣaṭkṛśānumitikaṃ <36> taduttaraṃ| vedavāhu <24> mitiyuk taduttaraṃ etasyasaṃpūrṇaphalasyārddhapramā ṇamevaṣaṭsaptatyuttarapaṃcaśatāṃgulāni <506> aṣṭacatvāriṃśadvyaṃ gulāni <48> dvādaśa <12> prativyaṃgulānisaṃpūrṇapadyakvaḍakṣetrapha laṃbhavatītidhyeyaṃ aṣṭāsrakuṃḍesvaṣṭautryasrāṇitatrapūrvapaścimota radakṣiṇasthānicatvāritryasrāṇisamabhujānitatrabhujamānaṃ trayodaśāṃgulāni <13> ekonacatvāriṃśa <36> dvyaṃgulāni laṃvamā naṃtrayodaśāṃgulāni bhūmimānaṃnavāṃgulaṃdvivyaṃgulasahitaṃ bhū myarddhamānasyalaṃvamānenaguṇanānniṣpannāṃkatricatvāriṃśa dvyaṃgulasahitāṣṭapaṃcāśaṣṭagulapratyāyekaikatryasramā naṃ āgneyanairṛtyavāyavyeśānavidik || ||

nayasyaivatesaṃtitadarthamevasāmānyavidherasyopādānasyā| vaśyakatvāt anyathātādṛśadevatānāṃpūjākiṃnakartavyāka rtavyācetkadetiśaṃkāyāupaśamānāpateḥ tadvyatirekasthaletu śaṃkaivanāstītidhyeyaṃ aṃgādilokapālāṃtamityādināṃgade vatānāmagrevaktavyatayāpunarupādānamasaṃlagnakamitiśaṃ kāpyatevaparāhanā padārthādarśakṛtastu ihāpyaṃgādipada maṃgāvaraṇādiparameva ayamāśayaḥ mukhyadevegaṃdhapuṣpedatvāṃ gāvaraṇadevatāḥpūjayitvādhūpadīpādikuryāditi aṃgādī npūjayedityuktaṃ tatrādipadagrāsvasvasvaviśeṣāvaraṇadevatā nāṃsvasvakalpevatatratrā(?)māsyānādināvaktavyatvepiaṃgādi lokapālādisāmānyāvaraṇānāṃsāmānyakalpevavaktumu citatvāttayoḥsthānathānaprayogānvaktumādiśavdārthaṃvaprakaṭa yituṃpunaḥsaṃgṛhṇātiaṃgādilokapālāṃtamityāhuḥ atredaṃpra tibhāti evaṃtarhiprāthamikevāṃgādīnityatratatsthānādyā kāṃkṣāyāutthitāyāḥkutonopaśamaḥkṛtaḥkutovāgrenutthitā mapyākāṃkṣāṃpunarutthāpyatannivṛtikaraṇamityatravījaṃvaktavyaṃ asmanmatetusveṣṭadevaṃtasyaivasamakakṣyamatevāṃgabhūtaṃśarīra bhūtamatevavakṣāmārṇāgādyāvaraṇadevatānāmādibhūtaṃmu khyatulyatayāprathamamabhipūjyagaṃdhādinaivedyāṃnasakalopacā raiḥsaṃpūjyaḥkṣamāpyājñāṃgṛhītvāpaścādaṃgādyāvaraṇadevatāḥpūjyā ititadānīmevasthānādyākāṃkṣayātannirūpaṇamitinakiṃcida samaṃjasaṃ pratyutaḥpradhānasamakakṣadevatānāṃtaṃtrāṃtarapratipā ditasyapūjanasyātrānuktyānyūnatvāyatistvanmatevabhavatī ti atevadattātreyapriyamatodhūpadīpādibhistathā ||

māvṛttirīritā lokeśailoṇyamaṃtrasyavidhānamitikīrtitaṃ va hnimūrttayojātahedaḥprabhṛtayaḥpūrvamuktevaśūlahastādiśa ktirāha śūlahastāṃvikeśīdāruṇālavaṇapriyā varākarā līvātyugrātāmasyaścāṣṭaśaktayaḥ utkaṭādīnāha utkaṭo vikaṭākṣaścaśūlahastomahāvalaḥ agnijahnaḥkhaḍgadharaḥ kapālītāraṇapriyaviti lokapālāḥkathitāeva vajrā dayopyatralokapālapadenaivasaṃgrāhyāḥ sarvatrasāhacaryāt aṣṭāvaraṇatvaṃtunāmīṣāṃ paṃcamāvṛttirīritetyataḥ paṃcāvara ṇapakṣasyaivadhananāt yathāhi śrīrājarājeśvarasyadattātreyā numatatryāvaraṇapakṣeiṃdrādibhiḥsahavajrādīnāmekāvaraṇa tvaṃrudrayāmalādiṣuspaṣṭamuktaṃ tathehāpitayorekāvaraṇa tvasyavaktuṃśakyatvāditimaṃtavyaṃ maṃtrasyāsyadevatācatuṣṭaya muktaṃtatpuraścaraṇādāveva prayogetuvaśyākarṣaṇarūpeagnī rātriścadevatenatutaccatuṣṭayaṃ evaṃmāraṇaprayogedurgābhadrakā lyāvevadevatenataccatuṣṭayamityāha agnītyādinā prayogā nāha jānvityādinā rātroṃjānupramāṇejalesthitvāmanuma ṣṭottarasahasrādisaṃkhyayājapataḥ sādhvovaśībhavatitvekaḥ prayogaḥ nābhimātrejalesthitvāṣṭottarasahasrasaṃkhyayārātrau japatopiphalametaditidvitīyaḥ kaṃṭhamātrejalesthitvāta tsaṃkhyayājapatobhūyāvaśībhavetītitṛtīyaḥpakṣaḥ pūrvapra yogayorapilaghugurubhāvasatvenanarasāmānyotkṛṣṭanarava śyaviṣayalaṃkramādūhanīyaṃ nahilaghugurupakṣayoḥsamānaṃ phalaṃvrāhmaṇāpiśakyaṃvakṣuṃ yatsādhyanāmavarṇavidabhita muktamaṃtraṃtāḍapatrelikhitvākṣīramiśritajasekvathayetsasā dhyovakṣībhavatītyaparaḥprayogaḥ tāḍapatremaṃtraṃlikhitvābhadra
kālyāḥprāsādenikhananādapipūrvaṃphalaṃ evaṃvilikhyetyanena sādhyanāmavidarbhitatvamatrāpikāryyamityuktaṃ maṃtraṃsādhyanāmavi darbhitaṃkṛtvātāḍapatrelikhitvākhadirakāṣṭaprajvalitāgnautatpa traṃmāsamātraṃtāpayatośuktaṃphalaṃ trikoṇakuṃḍegavyadugdhenapra kṣālyakarkarāpanayanādināśodhitasaiṃdhavalavaṇasyasamyak cūrṇaṃkṛtvātaddhomātsaptāhaparyaṃtaṃphalaṃjanavaśyatvarūpaṃsyādityaṃ paraḥprayogaḥtrikoṇakuṃḍevadadhimadhughṛtayuktaiḥ seṃdhavala vaṇairjuhvatovaśyamevapṛthivīpatirvaśīsyādityaparaḥ prayogaḥ prakṣālanādināśuddhaṃsaiṃdhavalavaṇaṃprasthamātramānīyatatpaṃca dhāvibhajyatadaikaikabhāgenaprathamādikramādekaikayāṛvāpaṃ cadinaparyaṃtamekaikadineyasyavaśyatāmudiśyamaṃtrīyāmukapa dadvayasthāneyannāmollikhetsopamavaśyaṃvaśībhavedityaparaḥ prayogaḥ pūrvavadevaśuddhalavaṇamekonapaṃcāśadāvṛtyājuhu topikathitaphalasiddhiḥ śatruvaśīkaraṇepiśuddhalavaṇasyai vahomaḥ ghṛtamadhuśarkarātmakamadhuratrayasaṃyuktairlavaṇairhomā nnarādivaśyatābhavatītyaparaḥprayogaḥ pūrvaṃdadhnoniveśaḥsāṃpra taṃśarkarāyāitibhedānnapaunarukṣmaṃ atevamadhuratrayamadhyeda dhnevābhiniveśonaśarkarāyāitivadatāṃmataṃ namūlānumata mitipratīyate anyathāpaunaruktyāpatteḥ prayogāṃtaramāha maṃ tramityādinā aṣṭamītadīyaivakṛṣṇāṣṭamī sāṃgopāṃgāiti kahastahṛtpārśvakaṭīyatskaṃdhaukaṃdharābhujau pṛṣṭaṃtathodaraṃurū jaṃghe ityaṃmasaṃgrahaḥkaṃśiraḥ pātpādaḥ kaṃdharāgrīvā hastoma ṇivaṃdhottarabhāgaḥ bhujasūtpūrvabhāgaḥ upāṃgānibhrūpuṭaucatā rāgaṃḍaucanāsikā oṣṭauvadaśanājihvācivukāsyaṃsanābhica jaghanaṃyoniguhyecajānunīmaṇivaṃdhakau ṣaṣṭīgulphautathāṃgulyaḥ
karayoḥpādayostūleiti saumyāṃsuṃdarīṃpaṃcāpiṃdvādaśāṃgulāḥ sarvāvayavāḥ aṃgopāṃgarūpāḥ pūrvokteva prāṇamaṃtrakṛtaṃyaṃtraṃe tadagnimapaṭalevakṣyamāṇaṃ prāṇapratiṣṭāpaneviśeṣastaṃtrāṃtare puttalikāyāhṛdayaṃspṛśanjīvihasthitityaṃtaṃjapet iṃ driyāṇispṛśansarveṃdriyāṇivāṅmanonayanaśrotraghrāṇe tiparyaṃtaṃ sarvāṃgaṃspṛśanprāṇāitārabhyasarvaṃśiraḥ spṛśa nsvāhetihuyediti mātṛkānyāsaḥ pūrvokteva maṃtranyā samevāhū niṭītyādinā atrastanayugmapadaṃkadidvayapadaṃca dvidvisthānavivakṣayābhihitaṃ śrutyordṛśoścadvivacanāde vadvidvisthānatvavivakṣovagamaḥ nāsāyāekatvādekasthā navodhakapadābhyāṃsahadvaṃdvakaraṇāccaikasthānatvavivakṣā lābhaḥ kukṣoḥsthānadvayarūpatayaivatathātvamapratyūhaṃ tathā camūrddhādiyāmvaṃtaṃviṃśatisthānānisiddhāni durvādikā nāmapiḍātyekaṃdvidvisthānatvabhramomābhūdityevamarthaṃśiṣṭa mityādināpunarāraṃbhaḥ dāruṇāsādhyanakṣatravṛkṣīyakāṣṭena khanet nikhanet nikhananaṃsarvāsāmapipratyekaṃdvyaṃgulādha stāt adhomukhīmiti sikyamayīputtalyabhiprāyeṇa vakṣya māṇamāraṇaprayogesarvāsāmapyadhomukhī tvādaraṇādvātatho ktiḥ prastutetuvaśyaprayogeputtalītrayasyāpiuttānasyaivani khananaṃnādhomukhasyā yaduktaṃkuṃḍāṃtaṃdvyaṃgulādhonikhanatu tarujāṃmūrttimuttānarūpāmiti uttānaṃdāravīṃkuṃḍenikhane nmaṃtrimaṃtritāmityācāryāśvavruvate dhūmenaspṛśyamānāmupari mayanajāṃlayedrarddhapādāṃ laṃvayedaṃvaresikthamayīmūrddhāmadhomu khīmityādivacanasiddhatvaṃhisikthamayyāḥputtalyādhomu
